entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A black-green gorgon assassin and former planeswalker from Ravnica, Ochran assassin and Queen of the Golgari Swarm, compleated and later cured.

entities.name: Phyrexian Vraska
entities.description: Vraska after compleation, with a scorpion-like tail and serpentine lower body, who led the invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: Echoverse Vraska
entities.description: An alternate Vraska from the Echoverse who grew up supported by the guilds and became an ally of the Theorist.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker, Vraska's love, who splintered his personality and died in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who bargained with Vraska, offered her the Golgari guildmastership and forced her to serve him.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose mass arrest of Golgari led to Vraska's imprisonment.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The Azorius judge who issued the writ of mass arrest and was killed by Vraska.

entities.name: Ludmilla
entities.description: A gorgon blinded and killed in the Azorius detention compound.

entities.name: Jarad
entities.description: The Golgari guildmaster Vraska killed to take his place.

entities.name: Xeddick
entities.description: A telepathic kraul who removed Jace's mind block from Vraska and died helping her escape.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who worked with Vraska, was betrayed by her, and later disabled her compleated body.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who worked with Vraska on Ravnica.

entities.name: Hekara
entities.description: A Rakdos emissary killed by a possessed Lavinia and later resurrected as a blood witch.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: A Boros leader possessed by Bolas who killed Hekara.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer planeswalker Vraska summoned to remove the Immortal Sun from Ixalan.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor whose defeat led to Vraska's un-compleation.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A vedalken who helped Vraska retain control of the Golgari before being assassinated.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker used as an unwitting accomplice in the fake death of Dovin Baan and ally in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker who brought Vraska news that Jace was alive.

entities.name: Ranna Beleren
entities.description: Jace's mother, a healer who treated Vraska's phyresis.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A faerie who assembled the Thunder Junction outlaw team.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Oko's son who dueled Akul.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: An infant creature that could visualize every planar connection, taken by Jace and Vraska.

entities.name: Akul
entities.description: An infamous dragon outlaw who held five of the six keys.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A gorgon created by Jace from part of his soul who inherited his spark.

entities.name: The Theorist
entities.description: The cold, determined aspect of Jace that came to dominate his splintered personality and tried to overwrite the Multiverse with the Echoverse.

entities.name: The Detective
entities.description: An aspect of Jace who guided the planeswalkers through his mindscape.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: A planeswalker recruited to overcome Jace's illusions.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Vraska escape the collapsing Echoverse.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The Duskmourn demon who captured Loot.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of which Vraska became Queen and guildmaster.

entities.name: Ochran
entities.description: A mercenary organization of assassins Vraska belonged to.

entities.name: Kraul
entities.description: A Golgari people who allied with Vraska.

entities.name: Erstwhile
entities.description: Undead creatures who helped Vraska establish herself as guildmaster.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A Ravnican sphinx and legendary Lawbringer confronted at Orazca.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact on Ixalan removed by Tezzeret using his Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: A compass given by Bolas that Vraska used to find the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: Vraska's home plane.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Vraska captained the Belligerent and met Jace.

entities.name: Vryn
entities.description: Jace's home plane where Vraska recovered.

entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane of the vault Jace and Vraska plundered.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane where Loot was lost in the House.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where Jace and Vraska rested.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: The mirror multiverse where Jace died.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane where Vraska was compleated.

entities.name: Meditation Plane
entities.description: Bolas's plane where Vraska met him and where Jace's spell failed.

entities.name: Duskend Purges
entities.description: The Azorius mass arrest and prison riot in which Vraska's spark ignited.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion, in which Vraska led the assault on Ravnica.

events.summary: The Azorius Senate orders a mass arrest of Golgari and Vraska is imprisoned.
events.quote: issued a writ of mass arrest for any people caught bearing allegiance to the Golgari

events.summary: Vraska is held blindfolded in a detention cell while the gorgon Ludmilla is blinded and killed.
events.quote: Vraska was kept blindfolded with broken ribs in standing water for weeks

events.summary: Vraska's planeswalker spark ignites as she is beaten near death, throwing her to another plane.
events.quote: She was severely beaten and lay near death when her planeswalker's spark ignited

events.summary: Vraska returns to Ravnica and begins her vengeful assassinations.
events.quote: Two years after her disappearance, she returned to Ravnica

events.summary: Vraska tries to force Jace Beleren into her service, but he escapes.
events.quote: Vraska attempted to force Jace Beleren into her service

events.summary: Bolas offers to make Vraska guildmaster of the Golgari if she retrieves an item from Orazca on Ixalan.
events.quote: Nicol Bolas offered to make her the guildmaster of the Golgari

events.summary: Vraska poses as a member of the Brazen Coalition and assembles her crew.
events.quote: Vraska posed as a member of the Brazen Coalition

events.summary: Vraska finds the shipwrecked, memoryless Jace and spares him.
events.quote: Seeing that he had no memory of who he was, she spared him

events.summary: Jace's memories return and he forgives Vraska for her past transgressions.
events.quote: Jace instead forgave Vraska for her past transgressions against him

events.summary: Jace uses the Living Guildpact to banish the sphinx Azor to Useless Island.
events.quote: Vraska witnessed how Jace used his power as the Living Guildpact to banish the Sphinx to Useless Island

events.summary: Vraska has Jace remove her memories of him so Bolas cannot read them.
events.quote: Vraska asked Jace to remove all her memories of him

events.summary: Vraska summons Tezzeret, who removes the Immortal Sun from Ixalan.
events.quote: Vraska summoned Tezzeret

events.summary: Vraska kills Jarad and establishes herself as Golgari guildmaster.
events.quote: Vraska killed Jarad and established herself as guildmaster

events.summary: Xeddick removes Jace's mind block, restoring Vraska's memories.
events.quote: found out about Jace's mind block and removed it at her request

events.summary: Vraska leads Golgari forces into Orzhova as a distraction so Kaya can kill the Obzedat.
events.quote: she led an army of rot zombies, trolls, and giant insects into Orzhova as a distraction

events.summary: Bolas forces Vraska to choose and she betrays Ral Zarek and Kaya.
events.quote: she ultimately betrayed them

events.summary: Vraska kills Isperia after the guild summit.
events.quote: Vraska killed Isperia after the guild summit as payback for the suffering of her youth

events.summary: Vraska's betrayal leads to Hekara's death at the hands of a possessed Lavinia.
events.quote: Vraska's betrayal led to the Rakdos emissary Hekara being killed by a Bolas-possessed Lavinia

events.summary: Vraska returns to Ravnica, unites the Golgari and pledges them against Bolas.
events.quote: Vraska united the Golgari once again and pledged the guild to the fight against Bolas

events.summary: Vraska represents the Golgari in the ritual restoring the Living Guildpact.
events.quote: Vraska served as the representative for the Golgari Swarm

events.summary: Jace forgives Vraska and promises to get together with her if they survive.
events.quote: Jace forgave her and promised to get together with her if they made it out of the war alive

events.summary: Vraska and Jace share a kiss at the Planewide Celebration.
events.quote: where she and Jace finally shared a kiss

events.summary: Vraska and Dovin Baan fake his death, with Vraska severing his hand.
events.quote: during the fight, Vraska severed Baan's right hand to use as proof of a kill

events.summary: Vraska is caught by the Phyrexians and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum.
events.quote: she was caught by the Phyrexians and forced to fight in Sheoldred's Coliseum

events.summary: Vraska is compleated and infects Jace in turn.
events.quote: Vraska succumbed to the Phyrexian influence and infected Jace in turn

events.summary: The compleated Vraska leads the invasion of Ravnica and blinds Ravnicans in vengeance.
events.quote: she instructed her forces to blind the Ravnicans

events.summary: Ral Zarek disables Vraska's body with a sonic device and Jace spirits her away to Vryn.
events.quote: Ral Zarek was able to disable Vraska's body with a sonic device that neutralized glistening oil

events.summary: Ranna burns most of the oil from Vraska, curing her.
events.quote: she burned most of the oil away and regenerated new tissue

events.summary: Vraska realizes she has lost her planeswalker spark.
events.quote: Vraska realized that she had lost her planeswalker's spark

events.summary: Vraska recruits Malcolm and Breeches on Ixalan for Jace's plan.
events.quote: Vraska found an Omenpath from Vryn to Ixalan and traveled there to recruit Malcolm and Breeches into their plan

events.summary: Jace disguises himself as Ashiok and hires Oko to assemble a team of outlaws on Thunder Junction.
events.quote: Jace disguised himself as Ashiok and hired Oko to put together a team of outlaws

events.summary: Vraska turns Akul's captors to stone as Oko's team escapes Tarnation.
events.quote: Tinybones reassembled and unlocked their chains, allowing Vraska to turn their remaining captors to stone

events.summary: Jace opens the vault and claims Loot; Vraska tries to petrify Oko, who escapes.
events.quote: Vraska attempted to petrify him, but he escaped

events.summary: Loot is captured by the demon Valgavoth in the House.
events.quote: Loot was captured by the demon Valgavoth

events.summary: Jace knocks Chandra unconscious to recover Loot.
events.quote: he rendered her unconscious, recovering Loot

events.summary: Jace's spell to remake the Multiverse fails and he is unmade.
events.quote: Jace cast his spell anyway, and she watched in horror as it failed

events.summary: Chandra and Ajani tell Vraska that Jace is still alive.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar and Ajani Goldmane walked through the front door bearing the news that Jace was still alive

events.summary: Vraska is separated from the others in a memory trap.
events.quote: Vraska became entangled in a memory trap and got separated from the others

events.summary: Vraska petrifies her Echoverse double and stabs the Theorist, letting Jace's aspects banish him.
events.quote: stabbed him in the heart, allowing Jace's aspects to join forces and banish the Theorist

events.summary: Jace dies in Vraska's arms.
events.quote: His final words were thanks to his Captain, and he passed away

events.summary: Vraska holds a funeral for Jace on Vryn, and Tam asks for her help.
events.quote: Tam responded that she didn't know, but she hoped Vraska would help her find out

relations.note: Resented the Azorius and sought vengeance against them.
relations.quote: She resented the order of the Azorius

rejected.summary: The planeswalkers' Echoverse counterparts imprison them in mental prisons.
rejected.quote: they were confronted by their respective Echoverse counterparts, who overcame them and threw them into mental prisons
